text: Entry Requirements 1. Status Applicants must be citizens of a country other than the People's Republic of China, hold a valid passport or citizenship certificate from their own countries for more than 4 years (inclusive), and have a record of actual residence outside of China for more than 2 years within the recent 4 years (before April 30 of the year of admission). Note that actual residence outside of China for more than 9 months in a year may be counted as 1 year, based on the dates of the entry and exit stamp on the passport. Applicants must be in good physical and mental health, have no record of bad behaviour, and abide by China's laws. 2. For bachelor's degree programme applicants (1) Generally, applicants for bachelor's degree programmes shall be within the age range of 18 to 25. (2) Applicants must have sufficient financial resources to support their studies and living in China. (3) Applicants must have graduated from a high school or equivalent institution and be awarded a high school diploma or higher. Applicants must have chosen the science stream in their high school studies, which, besides Mathematics and English language, should comprise pure science subjects like Biology, Chemistry and Physics. The admission criteria are detailed below: For English-medium programmes: (4) In general, the applicants should be graduating from high school in the current year of the intended university enrollment, with good academic and behaviour records at school. (5) Under the same conditions, applicants to English-medium programmes with an HSK certificate will be given preferential consideration. (6) For international students under the age of 18 whose parent(s) are not ordinarily residing in China, the parent(s) must formally appoint a foreigner or a Chinese citizen who is ordinarily residing in China as the guardian for the international student, and provide supporting documents. (7) Requirements for China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) a. According to the requirements of the higher authorities, starting from the 2026/2027 academic year, all international students applying for Bachelor's Degree Programmes are required to provide a valid CSCA transcript. b.
